Détermine le « % du risque » et le class: Determines the “% of risk” and the ranking of solutions. The VPR takes the likelihood of exploitation into account; where there is no VPR, the median of the severity is used.
Détermine le « % du risque » de chaque s: Determines each solution's “% of risk” and therefore their ranking.
Comment le « % du risque » est-il calcul: How is the “% of risk” calculated?
Le « % du risque » d'une solution est la: A solution's “% of risk” is the share of the scope's total risk that it removes. The scope is the set of findings retained above: the ticked severities, with the machines included and excluded.
% du risque = poids des constats de la s: % of risk = weight of the solution's findings ÷ weight of all findings in the scope × 100
Un constat est un couple machine / vulné: A finding is a machine / vulnerability pair, counted only once even if detected on several ports. Info findings are excluded.
Chaque constat reçoit un poids, selon la: Each finding is given a weight, according to the chosen weighting (table below).
La somme des poids de tous les constats: The sum of the weights of all findings is 100%. The sum for the findings a solution fixes gives its percentage.
Barème de sévérité de Tenable (celui du: Tenable's severity scale (the one behind the Security Center score): simple, but identical for all vulnerabilities of the same severity.
VPR du constat, de 0,1 à 10: VPR of the finding, from 0.1 to 10
Privilégie les vulnérabilités les plus s: Favours the vulnerabilities most likely to be exploited. Without a VPR: median of the severity (9.5 · 8.0 · 5.5 · 2.0).
Ajoute l'importance de la machine (ACR d: Adds the importance of the machine (ACR from 1 to 10). Without an ACR: Tenable's default value, 5.
Si le périmètre pèse 200 points au total: If the scope weighs 200 points in total and the findings fixed by “Mettre à jour Mozilla Firefox” weigh 35 points, that update removes 17.5% of the risk.
Le pourcentage est relatif au périmètre: The percentage is relative to the scope: if you change the severities or the machines, the total changes and so do all the percentages.
L'outil suppose qu'appliquer la solution: The tool assumes that applying the solution removes all the findings it groups.
Le score par machine, les tableaux par s: The score per machine, the tables by severity and the comparison of two exports are still calculated by severity.
L'AES et le CES ne servent pas à ce calc: The AES and CES are not used in this calculation: they are shown as Tenable provides them.
Si l'export ne contient pas d'ACR (cas d: If the export contains no ACR (the case with a Vulnerability Management CSV export), weighting by VPR and ACR gives the same ranking as weighting by VPR.
Ce pourcentage est calculé par l'outil :: This percentage is calculated by the tool: it may differ from the “risk reduction” shown by Tenable.
